Author: kkwills13
Message:
docs(spec): decide Q6 capability model — unblocks network-egress Phase 1 (#77)

* docs(spec): decide Q6 capability model — unblocks network-egress Phase 1

Resolves the last design gate on Phase 1 (open question 6). The Q6 acceptance
bar was already receipted in CI (capped child cannot mutate nftables/routes/
interfaces); this fixes the undecided piece — the helper's minimum privilege and
how it is acquired — grounded in the Phase 0 receipts:

- Privilege acquisition v1 = sudo -n (NOPASSWD receipted on both probed kernels);
  setuid/file-caps are named future alternatives, not v1.
- Helper minimum caps = CAP_NET_ADMIN + CAP_SYS_ADMIN, held only during setup.
- Child drop = CAP_NET_ADMIN + CAP_SYS_ADMIN from all five sets (the credential
  the passing Q6 gate exercises).
- Fail-closed: refuse to exec the child if privilege can't be acquired or caps
  can't be fully cleared. No advisory network fallback.
- Records the Phase 1 increment ordering: foundation (netns + default-drop base +
  cap-dropped child, Q7-independent) ships first; the selective allowlist (tproxy
  + DNS stub, gated on Q7) second.

* fix(spec): close capability model review findings
